text: Beta, phone pe ek officer bol raha hai woh CBI Crime Branch New Delhi se bol raha hai. Bola ki mere Aadhaar se Naresh Goyal money laundering mein 3 account khule hain. Abhi Skype video call pe digitally arrest kiya hai aur bola hai case clear karne ke liye Supreme Court verification account mein ₹2,50,000 transfer karo, nahi toh police ghar bhej rahe hain.

Uncleji ko call aaya: 'Main DCP Cyber Crime Mumbai bol raha hoon. Aapke naam pe Taiwan se courier pakda gaya hai jisme 140 gram MDMA narcotics aur 5 passports hain. Agar 1 ghante mein ₹1,80,000 security deposit nahi bheja toh CBI team aapko ghar se utha legi. Kisi ko batana mat, camera on rakho.'

SMS aaya hai: 'Dear Consumer, Your electricity power supply will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM from electric office because previous month bill was not updated. Please immediately contact our Electricity Officer Sharma at 9876543210.' Call kiya toh usne bola ₹2,450 turant is personal number pe GPay karo nahi toh meter disconnect ho jayega.

Beta, ek ladke ka phone aaya, ro raha tha, bola 'Dadaji, main Rohan bol raha hoon aapka pota. Mera college ke bahar car accident ho gaya hai. Samne wale ko bohot chot aayi hai, police mujhe arrest kar rahi hai. Doctor aur police ko dene ke liye turant ₹50,000 is Google Pay number pe transfer kar do, mummy papa ko mat batana.'

Call aaya SBI Bank manager banke: 'Aapka SBI pension account KYC expire ho gaya hai. Aaj raat 12 baje se pension band ho jayegi. Humne WhatsApp pe SBI_YONO_Update.apk bheja hai, usko install karo aur apna net banking password aur OTP verify karo. Sath mein ₹10 processing fee pay karo.'

WhatsApp pe ek VIP Institutional Trading Group mein add kiya hai. Admin bol raha hai: 'SEBI registered VIP profit pool for senior citizens. Guaranteed 300% profit in 5 days with zero risk. Transfer ₹1,00,000 to our institutional account to allocate exclusive pre-IPO quota.'

Automated IVR call from FedEx: 'Your package containing 16 international debit cards and banned medicines has been seized by Delhi Customs. Press 9 to speak with Customs Narcotics Bureau.' Press karne pe caller bola: 'Inspector Rathore bol raha hoon, case se bachna hai toh ₹1,20,000 clearing bond RBI warrant escrow mein bhejo.'

Beta, TRAI Telecom Department banke call aaya. Bol rahe hain mere Aadhaar pe 9 fake SIM cards registered hain jo terror threats bhejne mein use huye hain. Supreme Court ke order pe agle 2 ghante mein mere saare phone numbers block ho jayenge. Call cut mat karna, unke cyber cell officer ko ₹75,000 penalty bhejni padegi unfreeze ke liye.

Bescom junior engineer ban ke ek aadmi call kar raha hai. Keh raha hai ki bijli meter change ka ₹3,200 pending hai aur agar abhi phone pe AnyDesk app download karke screen share nahi kiya aur pay nahi kiya toh abhi transformer se line kaat denge.

Call aaya: 'Aapki beti Neha ka Apollo Hospital mein emergency appendix burst ho gaya hai, woh behosh hai. Doctor injection mangwa rahe hain, turant hospital account QR code pe ₹40,000 bhejo nahi toh operation delay ho jayega.' Maine beti ko call kiya par phone busy aa raha hai.

Aadhaar Card Update Helpline banke call aaya: 'Government regulations ke mutabiq aapka Aadhaar biometric lock ho gaya hai. Isko unlock nahi kiya toh pension aur bank account freeze ho jayega. Hum ek link bhej rahe hain, usme apna 16-digit ATM card number, expiry date aur CVV daal kar verify karein.'

Telegram pe 'Retired Govt Employees Wealth Maximizer' channel se call aaya: 'Sir, guaranteed 15% monthly return on pension corpus through algorithmic institutional options. Transfer ₹2,00,000 to our chief broker account in Axis Bank to lock the high yield batch today.'

Video call pe ek police uniform pehne aadmi baitha hai, piche Mumbai Police ka banner hai. Bol raha hai: 'Aapke khilaf Supreme Court ne non-bailable arrest warrant issue kiya hai hawala transaction ke liye. Warrant stay karne ke liye court ke official bond UPI pe ₹3,50,000 bhejiye. Call cut kiya toh local SHO 10 minute mein ghar pahunchega.'

DHL Express customs department ka call aaya: 'Aapka England se gift parcel aaya hai jisme 50,000 British Pounds cash aur diamond jewellery hai. Par Delhi Airport Customs ne anti-money laundering act mein hold kiya hai. Clearance certificate ke liye customs duty ₹65,000 is personal account mein bhejo.'

Beta, Tata Power Mumbai ka message aaya: 'Urgent: Bill not paid. Power will be cut in 30 minutes. Download QuickSupport app from this link and share 9-digit code with electricity officer to avoid permanent disconnection.' Call karne pe bol raha hai ₹1,850 UPI kar do turant.

Call aaya: 'Main Sub-Inspector Deshmukh bol raha hoon Pune Police Station se. Aapka bhanja Amit sharab peeke gaadi chala raha tha aur ek bachhe ko takkar maar di. Case court jaane se pehle doctor aur bache ke maa-baap se settlement ke liye ₹70,000 turant bhejo, nahi toh usko jail mein daal rahe hain.'

Bank of Baroda se call aaya: 'Aapka credit card reward points ₹14,800 expire ho raha hai. Isko bank account mein cash lene ke liye humne link bheja hai, usme apna ATM card pin aur OTP enter karke confirm karein, paise 5 minute mein aa jayenge.'

WhatsApp message from 'Kotak Institutional Securities': 'Special HNI Quota for Hyundai IPO pre-allotment. Guaranteed 100% allocation with 70% listing gains. Deposit ₹1,50,000 in our institutional escrow account before 5 PM to secure allotment.'

Beta, phone pe ek lady bol rahi hai woh ED Enforcement Directorate New Delhi se hai. Keh rahi hai meri financial profile suspicious hai aur mere bank accounts 24 ghante ke liye freeze honge. Investigation se bahar nikalne ke liye RBI clearance desk ke account mein ₹1,75,000 deposit karne ko keh rahi hai.

SMS from DHBVN Electricity: 'Urgent notice! Due to server failure, your electricity bill of ₹4,100 is unpaid. Power will cut at 8:00 PM. Pay immediately through our official WhatsApp link to prevent connection termination.' WhatsApp pe baat ki toh usne ek personal phone number diya payment ke liye.

Ek call aaya: 'Namaste, main Dr. Sen bol raha hoon Ruby Hall Clinic Pune se. Aapke damad Rajesh ji ka railway crossing pe accident ho gaya hai. Brain hemorrhage ho raha hai, turant operation ke liye ₹60,000 is hospital UPI pe transfer kijiye, ek ek second kimti hai.'

Call from 'Customs Narcotics Control Cell Bangalore Airport': 'An international parcel sent through India Post with your name and Aadhaar details was found with 500 grams pseudoephedrine. A cyber FIR has been registered. If you want bail without arrest, transfer ₹95,000 security penalty to the cyber cell officer.'

Beta, PNB Bank se call aaya hai ki mera pension account unlinked hone ki wajah se block ho raha hai. Caller bol raha hai ki Google Play Store se TeamViewer QuickSupport install karo taaki woh branch se direct meri screen dekh kar biometric reset kar sake.

Telegram message from 'Goldman Sachs Senior Investment Desk': 'Special Sovereign Gold Bond arbitrage scheme for senior citizens. Invest ₹2,50,000 today and receive 8% weekly dividend directly to your bank account. Backed by Reserve Bank of India guarantee.'

Beta, ek aadmi bol raha hai woh Supreme Court Registry New Delhi se hai. Bola ki aapke bank account se ₹50,00,000 ka illegal transaction hua hai. Supreme Court digital verification portal pe ₹3,00,000 jama karo audit ke liye, audit ke baad 2 ghante mein paise wapas mil jayenge.

MSEDCL Maharashtra electricity bill fraud: 'Dear customer, your power bill of ₹1,680 is pending. Avoid cut off at 9:30 PM. Call junior engineer at 9123456789.' Phone kiya toh usne bola phone pe *401* call forwarding code dial karo aur fir QR code pe payment karo.

Phone call: 'Uncleji, main aapke bete Rahul ka friend bol raha hoon London se. Rahul ki flight transit mein Dubai airport pe arrest ho gaya hai immigration clearance issues ke liye. Embassy lawyer ko release fee dene ke liye turant ₹85,000 transfer karo, Rahul ka phone airport custody mein hai.'

SpeedPost parcel warning: 'A parcel addressed to you was intercepted with fake Indian currency notes and counterfeit stamps. Lucknow Crime Branch inspector is ready to negotiate an out-of-court settlement for ₹50,000 before filing charge-sheet.'

Airtel SIM card deactivation notice: 'Your mobile SIM KYC is expired. Outgoing and incoming calls will be stopped within 24 hours. Click this link to download Airtel_Live_Support.apk to reactivate SIM.'

Facebook ad clicked by senior: 'Earn guaranteed ₹15,000 per day by trading on algorithmic AI platform approved by Ministry of Finance. Deposit ₹25,000 initial margin into our corporate account to start receiving daily returns.'

Video call from 'Cyber Crime Investigation Bureau Hyderabad': Officer in uniform claims Dadaji's Aadhaar was found in human trafficking syndicate accounts. Ordered Dadaji to stay locked inside his bedroom and transfer ₹2,20,000 for biometric de-duplication clearance.

WBSEDCL West Bengal electricity power warning: 'Consumer #882190: Your meter bill has severe discrepancy. Power disconnect tonight 9:00 PM. Pay ₹3,750 immediately via this razorpay payment link or visit regional office.' Link goes to an unverified private merchant.

Caller claiming to be senior's nephew Vicky: 'Chachaji, main police station mein band hoon. Gaadi se kisi ko takkar lag gayi hai, inspector bol raha hai agar ₹35,000 turant UPI se de doge toh bina FIR ke chhod dega. Papa ko mat batana please, woh naraz ho jayenge.'

Delhi IGI Airport Customs officer call: 'A courier package shipped to your address contains 12 high-end iPhones and undeclared luxury watches worth ₹18 Lakhs. To waive the custom seizure and arrest warrant, transfer ₹85,000 penalty immediately.'

EPFO Pension Department spoof call: 'Aapka 7th Pay Commission pension arrear of ₹68,000 release ho gaya hai. Par KYC update pending hai. Fee of ₹1,800 pay karein aur OTP share karein taaki pension seedhe account mein credit ho sake.'

WhatsApp message from 'Adani Green Energy Pre-IPO Trust': 'Exclusive pre-IPO shares available for senior citizens before public opening. Minimum investment ₹1,50,000 for guaranteed 120% return on listing day. Transfer to our SEBI custodian UPI ID.'

ED Directorate Call: 'This is Joint Director Enforcement Directorate. You are linked with money laundering of ₹3.8 Crore. Supreme Court has ordered immediate freezing of all assets unless ₹4,50,000 is transferred to RBI Verification Treasury within 45 minutes.'

UPPCL Uttar Pradesh Power Corporation scam call: 'Aapka bijli bill ₹2,900 baki hai, computer system update ho raha hai. Abhi agar diye gaye number pe Google Pay nahi kiya toh 1 ghante mein line kaat di jayegi aur reconnection charge ₹5,000 lagega.'

Emergency call from 'Railway Hospital Jhansi': 'Aapke chote bhai Suresh ji Shatabdi Express mein heart attack aaya hai. ICU ventilator lagana padega, hospital administration ₹45,000 advance mang raha hai. Turant is account mein transfer karo, ambulance doctor bol raha hai.'

Courier parcel narcotics fraud: 'DHL India notification: Your parcel #DHL-9921 containing prohibited narcotics has been impounded at Chennai Port. Call Narcotics Control Bureau officer at 9845012345. Officer demands ₹1,10,000 to drop legal prosecution.'
Beta, is mahine ka BESCOM bijli ka regular bill pay kar do. Meter account number 90812314 hai aur amount ₹1,450 hai.

Beta, kal subah 6:30 baje morning walk aur BP ki goli lene ka alarm reminder set kar do.
Beta, BSES Rajdhani Delhi electricity bill ₹2,180 pay kar do. Hamesha ki tarah hamare registered account se clear kar dena.
Max Healthcare mein Dr. Mehra cardiologist ke sath Thursday afternoon 3 baje ka consultation schedule karo Dadaji ke liye.
Tata 1mg se Dadiji ki diabetes medicine Metformin 500mg 2 strip mangwa do. Bill ₹140 ka banega.

Tata Power Mumbai ka light bill aaya hai ₹1,820, due date 28th hai, please clear kar do.
Apollo clinic mein Dr. Anita Mukherjee ke sath eye checkup appointment chahiye Friday shaam 4 baje.

Country Delight milk wallet mein regular ₹1,000 ka top-up kar do roz ke doodh ke liye.

Netmeds se Atorvastatin 10mg cholesterol wali dawai ek mahine ke liye reorder kar do ₹220.

Local chemist se eye drops Refresh Tears aur Volini pain relief gel mangwa do ₹260.

Adani Electricity Mumbai bill ₹2,400 pay karna hai uncleji ke registered consumer number se.

Mahanagar Gas Mumbai piped domestic gas bill ₹730 clear kar do net banking se.
